title: Stop hidden projects laying out and painting their terminals
notes: Measured: 4 workers at 200 lines/s: renderer 23.8-26.9% CPU shown, still 12.6-14.5% and 195-200 layouts/10 s when the project is hidden (idle 0%). Where: .page[hidden] is visibility:hidden (src/renderer/app/index.css:72), so xterm's IntersectionObserver never pauses. Fix (medium): take hidden pages out of the viewport keeping their size; check panes show latest output on return. Rerun: measure.mjs streams. From profiling card dca04e6f, docs/performance/history.md 2026-11-02.

comments.body: Shipped in #179: hidden pages and views translate off screen so xterm pauses them, and paused-selection.ts holds xterm's selection redraw (which bypassed the pause) until the terminal is back. Hidden renderer CPU 15.5-19.0% to 7.2-10.9%, layouts per 10 s 192-356 to 1. Not done: the same redraw still rebuilds shown terminals on every scroll.
